hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.java$'; then echo "[hook] Java file saved: $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|DROP TABLE|truncate'; then if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '\.claude/worktrees/'; then exit 0; fi; echo 'Blocked: destructive command detected' && exit 2; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qi 'sync-showcase\.sh'; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qi 'showcase' && echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE 'push|--force'; then echo 'Blocked: direct push/force touching the showcase repo. Run scripts/sync-showcase.sh instead -- it strips sale-sensitive files before pushing. See feedback_showcase_mirror memory for why.' && exit 2; fi

cd C:/workspaces/SpringAIClaude/AIHealthcare && JAVA_FILES=$( { git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null; git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null; } | grep '\.java$' | sed 's|.*/||;s|\.java$||' | sort -u ) && [ -z "$JAVA_FILES" ] && exit 0; TEST_LIST=''; for cls in $JAVA_FILES; do TFILE=$(find . -path '*/src/test*' -name "${cls}Test.java" -not -path '*/target/*' 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$TFILE" ] && TEST_LIST="${TEST_LIST}${cls}Test,"; done; TEST_LIST="${TEST_LIST%,}"; [ -z "$TEST_LIST" ] && exit 0; echo "[stop-hook] Selective tests: $TEST_LIST"; mvn test -Dtest="$TEST_LIST" --no-transfer-progress 2>&1 | tail -40; [ "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" -eq 0 ] && exit 0 || exit 2
